late.exception: Illness extensions require medical evidence before the deadline.

late_exam.rule: Late submission is accepted without penalty for two days after the published deadline.
late_exam.exception: Illness extensions require medical evidence within seven days after the deadline.

password.rule: Reset a forgotten password using the recovery link.
password.exception: If the link has expired, contact the IT help desk with your student ID, for example at the service counter in the main library or by telephone during office hours.

assignment.rule: Upload assignments through the learning portal.
assignment.exception: If the portal is unavailable, email the file to the course coordinator before the deadline and keep the delivery receipt.

contractor.rule: Contractors can work remotely only if the signed contract permits it.
contractor.exception: Employee rules do not apply to contractors.

printer.rule: For blank printer pages, check ink levels and run the cleaning utility.
printer.exception: If the test page is still blank after two cleaning cycles, replace the ink cartridge and record the fault in the equipment log.
